messages:
alisa (PM): Heads-up — Customer Gamma wants a pilot of the Optimize toolkit. They care about batching + quant recs first, then eval-triggered alerts. We need a minimal acceptance checklist and a deployment path (dark launch -> canary -> opt-in). Can we sketch scope and constraints?

mohan (eng): Ok. Suggest we ship a narrow alpha that includes: batching heuristics, prefix/KV cache opt-in, and a quant recommendation engine (no automatic quantize). Keep rollout flags.

sven (ml): For quant recs we should provide per-model suggestions and an estimated quality delta. Must include a small eval harness to surface regressions vs baseline.

elaine (CS): Gamma will run on Dedicated and Private. Their constraints: no model weight changes on-prem, and they want all evals to run on sampled production prompts, not only synthetic. Also need clear rollback criteria.

tess (prod-ops): Operational constraints: we can dark-launch to 5% of tenants, then 25% canary for 24h. Metrics to monitor: p95 latency, tail OOMs, token cost delta, and eval quality delta.

nate (solutions): Customer ask: ability to pin per-tenant quant profile and opt-out of automated batch suggestions. Also want an API to request re-run of evals on demand.

mohan (eng): Implementation notes: batching heuristics + cache are runtime-only. Quant recs require offline profiling job that outputs a "recommendation bundle" JSON. We can expose it in Console and via API. Minimal feature-flag rollout: 

```
FEATURE_FLAGS={
  "optimize_toolkit_alpha": "off",
  "batching_heuristics_v1": "on:dark(5%)",
  "quant_recs_v1": "canary(25%)"
}
```

sven (ml): Eval-triggered alerting design: customers upload a golden prompt set. We compute baseline metrics (ROUGE/LL/LLR-like proxies). If quality delta > 2% absolute or model drift > 3% relative across 3 consecutive runs, send an infra + CS alert.

elaine (CS): Rollback gating: if customer sees >1% user-facing regression (reported via CS) OR platform detects eval alert, we auto suspend recommendations and notify the customer. Need a manual override in Console.

alisa (PM): Great. Can we convert to a short acceptance checklist for Gamma pilot? Keep it lean.

mohan (eng): Draft acceptance checklist: 
- Feature flags available for Dedicated + Private.
- Batching heuristics applied with no p95 latency regression > 50ms versus baseline.
- Quant recs delivered as read-only recommendations plus per-tenant pin/opt-out.
- Eval harness runs on sampled production prompts; automated alerting if quality delta > 2%.
- No customer model weights modified during pilot (no automatic quantize).
- Rollback in Console and automatic suspend on eval alert.

alisa (PM): Add success metrics: unit cost reduction >= 15% on batched workloads, false-positive eval alerts < 10% in first 2 weeks, and 99.9% uptime for the pilot endpoints.

tess (prod-ops): Monitoring / dashboards to build:
- Per-tenant: token cost trend, avg latency, p95 latency, batch size histogram.
- Eval dashboard: baseline vs current quality, alert history.
- Safety: OOM / memory pressure events.

nate (solutions): On onboarding: we need a clear runbook for Gamma — steps to opt in, data-sampling instructions, how to interpret recs, and contact points for rollback. CS should lead first 2 onboarding sessions.

elaine (CS): I'll own customer comms + initial eval-run. Also request a one-click CSV export of eval results for audits.

mohan (eng): Timeline proposal:
- Week 0: internal alpha (runtime + basic recs UI).
- Week 2: dark launch (5% tenants) + initial dashboards.
- Week 3: canary (25%) + extended eval monitoring.
- Week 4: opt-in pilot with Gamma + weekly check-ins.

alisa (PM): Dependencies: runtime batching changes + cache (eng), profiling jobs & recs pipeline (ml), console flags + dashboards (prod-ops), onboarding docs + runbooks (CS).

sven (ml): Quick note about eval thresholds: we should allow per-customer thresholds. Default: quality delta threshold = 2% absolute, but Gamma can set tighter/looser. Make it configurable in Console.

mohan (eng): Ops question: Private deployments may not have our profiler running. Plan: provide a profiling binary customers can run locally that uploads a recommendation bundle (no model weights). Document the command: 

```
./optimize-profiler --sample-file prompts.csv --output recs.json --mode read-only
```

nate (solutions): Also add a sample contract clause for the pilot: no SLA changes, pilot is for recommendations only, customer retains control to apply quantization.

deploy-bot: New canary slice created: optimize_toolkit_alpha -> 25% (started by mohan).

elaine (CS): Quick risk callout: eval-triggered alerts may generate noisy tickets early. Let's include a "quiet period" of 48h where alerts are info-only (no auto-suspend) for new customers.

alisa (PM): Agree — add quiet period to runbook and a toggle per customer. POV: keep default quiet period = 48h, optional to disable.

mohan (eng): Action items:
- I will wire feature flags + dark launch config (ETA 5 business days).
- sven: build profiling job + recs output schema (ETA 7 days).
- tess: dashboard templates + alert plumbing (ETA 6 days).
- elaine: onboarding runbook + customer comms (ETA 4 days).

alisa (PM): I'll sync with Gamma and confirm pilot start window. Thanks everyone — let's aim to ship the narrow alpha and run the dark launch next week. :thumbsup:

nate (solutions): +1. I'll prepare the sample onboarding deck and contract language.

mohan (eng): Noted. I'll post updates in #eng-runtime when feature flags are wired.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout complete: optimize_toolkit_alpha -> 25% (healthy).
